10.title: Nobel Prize Day
10.description:
Nobel Prize Day is on December 10th. It celebrates[称える] the Nobel Prizes[賞] given to people who help the world in important[重要] ways[方法].

Alfred Nobel was a scientist[科学者] from Sweden. He used his money for the prizes. The prizes are for:

Peace[平和]

Science[科学]

Medicine[医学]

Literature[文学]

Economics[経済学]

It is a day to think about people who help the world.

16.title: Las Posadas
16.description:
Las Posadas is a celebration that starts on December 16th. It is celebrated in Mexico[メキシコ].

It remembers the story[物語] of Mary[マリア] and Joseph[ヨセフ] looking for a place to stay before Jesus was born.

Families and friends walk together and sing special[特別な] songs. Children often hit a piñata[ピニャータ], which is a colorful shape filled with candy[お菓子].

Las Posadas is a time for friends[友だち], family[家族], and fun[楽しい時間].

22.title: Dongzhi Festival
22.description:
The Dongzhi Festival is on December 22nd. It is a celebration from China[中国].

Dongzhi is the day with the shortest[一番短い] daylight of the year. After this day, the sunlight[日光] becomes longer again.

Families come together and eat special[特別な] foods. In China, many people eat tangyuan[湯円], which are sweet rice balls. In Taiwan, people also eat dumplings[餃子].

The Dongzhi Festival is a time for family[家族], warmth[あたたかさ], and good health[健康].

24.title: Christmas Eve
24.description:
Christmas Eve is on December 24th. It is the night before Christmas[クリスマス].

Many families spend time together and eat a special[特別な] dinner. Some people go to church[教会]. Children often get excited because Santa Claus[サンタクロース] may bring presents[プレゼント].

People enjoy lights, music[音楽], and a warm holiday feeling[休日の気分].

Christmas Eve is a time for relaxing[リラックス] with family[家族].

25.title: Christmas Day
25.description:
Christmas Day is on December 25th. It celebrates the birth[誕生] of Jesus[イエス] for many Christians[キリスト教徒].

Children often open presents[プレゼント] in the morning. Families eat a special[特別な] meal together. Many people enjoy relaxing[リラックス], watching movies[映画], or spending time with family[家族] and friends[友だち].

Christmas Day is a time of joy[喜び], sharing[分け合い], and warm feelings[あたたかい気持ち].

26.title: Boxing Day
26.description:
Boxing Day is on December 26th. It is celebrated in the UK[イギリス], Canada[カナダ], Australia[オーストラリア], and other countries.

A long time ago, rich[金持ち] people gave boxes[箱] of food or money to people who needed help.

Today, Boxing Day is a relaxing day[休む日]. Many people visit family[家族] or friends[友だち], eat leftover[残り物] Christmas food, or go shopping[買い物] because stores have big sales[セール].

Boxing Day is a day to rest[休む] or have fun[楽しむ].

31.title: New Year's Eve
31.description:
New Year’s Eve is on December 31st. It is the last day of the year. Many people have parties[パーティー], eat a special[特別な] dinner, and watch fireworks[花火]. Some families wait together until midnight[真夜中].

In many countries, New Year’s Eve is a fun night with friends[友だち], music[音楽], and celebration[お祝い].

01.title: World AIDS Day
01.description: World AIDS Day is a day to learn about HIV/AIDS[エイズウイルス／エイズ] and to support people who live with it. Many people wear a red ribbon[赤いリボン] to show care[思いやり] and understanding[理解].

02.title: International Day for the Abolition of Slavery
02.description: This day teaches about the history[歴史] of slavery[奴隷制度] and reminds[思い出させる] us that some people around the world are still treated unfairly[不公平に] or forced to work. It teaches us to respect freedom[自由] and human rights[人権].

03.title: International Day of Persons with Disabilities
03.description:
This day helps people learn about disabilities[障害] and how to make the world more accessible[利用しやすい]. It reminds us to treat everyone with kindness[優しさ] and respect[尊重].

05.title: Krampusnacht / Krampus Night
05.description: Krampus Night is celebrated in Austria[オーストリア] and some other European countries. Krampus[クランプス] is a scary creature[怖い生き物] from old stories. People wear costumes and walk in the streets. It is part of traditional[伝統的] winter celebrations before Christmas.

08.title: Bodhi Day
08.description:
Bodhi Day is the day Buddhists remember when the Buddha became very wise.
He sat under a big tree called the Bodhi Tree, thought deeply about the world, and learned how to live a peaceful and kind life.

菩提日は、仏教徒が仏陀が深い悟りを得た日を記念する日です。
仏陀は菩提樹と呼ばれる大きな木の根元に座り、世界の真理について深く思索を重ね、平和で慈愛に満ちた生き方を悟りました。

4.title: Hanukkah
4.description:
Hanukkah is a Jewish[ユダヤ人の] celebration that begins on the evening of December 4th. It lasts for eight days[8日間].

It remembers a miracle[奇跡] from a long time ago. There was only a little oil[油], but the light stayed on for eight days.

Families light a special candle holder[ろうそく立て] called a menorah[メノーラー]. Each night, they light one more candle.

People eat special foods, play a small spinning toy[回るおもちゃ] called a dreidel[ドレイドル], and spend time with family[家族].

Hanukkah is a time of light[光], hope[希望], and joy[喜び].

The Muppets Christmas Carol
content.text:
This movie is fun and easy to watch. It has many cute puppets[人形], music[音楽], and jokes[冗談]. The story teaches a good lesson[教訓] about being kind[親切] and helping[助ける] others.
It is also a famous[有名] Christmas story, so it is good for learning about Christmas culture[文化].
I think you will enjoy[楽しむ] this movie!

content.title: Elf
content.text:
This movie is very funny[おもしろい] and cheerful[明るい]. It is about a man who grows up with elves[妖精 yōsei] at the North Pole[北極 hokkyoku]. He goes to New York to find his real family[家族], and many silly[ばかげた] things happen.

The movie teaches us to believe[信じる] in ourselves and to be kind[親切] to others.

content.title: Home Alone
content.text: This movie is very fun and exciting[わくわくする]. A boy is alone[一人で] at home, and two thieves[泥棒] try to enter the house. He makes many clever[かしこい] traps[わな] to stop them, and it is very funny to watch.

content.title: Klaus
content.text:
This movie is beautiful[美しい] and funny. It is about a postman[郵便配達人] who goes to a cold, lonely[さびしい] town and meets a toy maker[おもちゃ職人] named Klaus. They start giving gifts[贈り物] to children, and the town becomes happy[幸せ] again.
I like this movie because it feels warm[あたたかい], has simple funny moments[面白い場面], and shows that small kindness[親切] can make big change[変化].
